name: get-shit-done
description: Get complex or fan-out work done: /get-shit-done:run decomposes a task, delegates each subtask to the cheapest capable model (Sonnet for well-scoped, Opus for hard) under an Opus/Fable orchestrator, runs concurrent Sonnet research (web + context7), and fans out through a checked dynamic workflow with an always-on Opus adversarial verification pass. Autonomous once invoked.
